title: console: what a save or bulk action tells the user: a bulk action reports Succeeded N / N whatever each row did, a warning save shows two toasts, a hook cannot add a sentence to the save toast, and Delete has no per-object confirm text
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.2.0** while implementing hotcrm#2371 (UX card "show users the result of what they did", from the #2320 browser pass). The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2371 comment 6487801082](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2371#issuecomment-6487801082), and the HotCRM side landed as hotcrm#2376. HotCRM worked around each item below where it could. What remains needs the console or the spec.

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A list bulk action that fans out per row (HotCRM's Add to Campaign, two leads selected) ends on "Succeeded 2 / 2", whatever each row's action did. When one row is refused, the dialog shows only the last refusal and drops the count. | Report succeeded / refused counts from each row's actual answer, and list every refusal, each with its record. |
| 2 | A save that passes with a warning-severity rule shows two toasts: "Saved — with warnings <msg>" and "<Object> "<name>" updated". | One toast: the save, carrying the warning. |
| 3 | No hook or flow can add a sentence to a save's toast. A save that sends a deal for approval cannot say so, so HotCRM shows a `record:alert` banner on the page instead. | A way for a `beforeUpdate` / `afterUpdate` hook, or a record-triggered flow, to attach one user-facing notice to the save's answer, which the console shows with or in place of the save toast. |
| 4 | Deleting a lead cascades its campaign memberships without saying so. `RowCrudActionOverrideSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1426` at 18.2.0) takes only `enabled` / `visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen`, so an object cannot word its Delete confirmation. | A `confirmText` on the delete override (with `{{count}}` / record holes as #25942 gave bulk actions), or a generated line naming the cascade-delete children. |

**Already carded, not asked again:** the per-step "Saved — next step" toast in a screen flow is #26578 (closed after 18.2.0).

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, as a card of its own where it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2371's report. Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for bulk action result counts, warning-save double toasts, hook save notices and delete confirm text. Related, closed: #26172 (save toasts name the record), #25942 (bulk confirmText holes), #7428. No open card.</sub>
